mapper.sql: b.bill_id AS "id",b.proj_id AS "projectId",b.bill_ord::int AS "order",b.bill_ym AS "billingMonth",b.bill_dt AS "billingDate", b.sply_amt AS "supplyAmount",b.vat_rt AS "vatRate",b.vat_amt AS "vatAmount",b.tot_amt AS "totalAmount", b.rcpt_sum_amt AS "receiptAmount",b.unpaid_amt AS "unpaidAmount",b.pay_due_dt AS "dueDate",b.tax_invc_no AS "taxInvoiceNo", (b.cncl_yn='Y') AS "cancelled",b.cncl_rsn AS "cancelReason",b.cncl_user_id AS "cancelUserId",b.cncl_dttm AS "cancelledAt", b.reg_user_id AS "regUserId",b.reg_dttm AS "registeredAt",b.mod_user_id AS "modUserId",b.mod_dttm AS "modifiedAt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_bl_bill b WHERE b.bill_id=#{id}

SELECT rcpt_id::bigint AS "id",bill_id AS "billId",rcpt_dt AS "date",rcpt_amt AS "amount",(cncl_yn='Y') AS "cancelled", cncl_rsn AS "cancelReason",cncl_user_id AS "cancelUserId",cncl_dttm AS "cancelledAt",reg_user_id AS "regUserId", reg_dttm AS "registeredAt",mod_user_id AS "modUserId",mod_dttm AS "modifiedAt" FROM tb_bl_rcpt WHERE bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY rcpt_id

SELECT p.proj_id AS "id",p.proj_nm AS "name",COALESCE(c.clnt_nm,'–') AS "customerName",p.ctrt_type_cd AS "contractType", p.proj_stat_cd AS "status",p.ctrt_end_dt AS "endDate" FROM tb_pj_proj p LEFT JOIN tb_bs_clnt c ON c.clnt_id=p.cust_clnt_id WHERE p.proj_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM tb_bl_bill b WHERE b.proj_id=#{projectId} ORDER BY b.bill_ym DESC,b.bill_id DESC
SELECT COALESCE(max(right(bill_id,3)::int),0) FROM tb_bl_bill WHERE bill_ym=#{month}
SELECT COALESCE(max(bill_ord),0)::int FROM tb_bl_bill WHERE proj_id=#{projectId}
SELECT std_val FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd=#{code} AND aply_bgn_ym<=#{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE tb_cl_close IN SHARE MODE
